correctness.rationale: The frozen Finding and its five-cycle proof misname the Desargues graph as the point-line incidence graph. That graph in the usual incidence convention has 20 point-vertices and 30 line-vertices (and 60 incidences), not 20 vertices. The corrected RESULT.md under repairs/1 distinguishes this once-subdivided graph from the graph with junctions as vertices and lines as edges; the latter is Desargues. Re-audit of the corrected claim: cyclic summation gives the integral sum-zero difference lattice. Weak signed regions with both signs have dimension |E|−1, and setting some support coordinates to zero gives exactly the face order, since strict signs on every mixed support are feasible. In the support dual lattice, shifting an integral representative by the maximum negative-block coordinate puts it in the singleton-generated semigroup; the one primitive relation gives the squarefree binomial chart. The two partial-derivative blocks vanish precisely when at least two coordinates vanish in each, in all characteristics. The minimal nonsmooth supports are exactly two plus and two minus; their open orbits see a node times a torus, giving generic transverse multiplicity two. Compatible labels have a least common coface, their mixed union, and conflicts have none. Projection to unused coordinates is integrally surjective with saturated kernel, and permitted signs on the existing support allow any prescribed outside sum to be compensated. Hence each quotient star is the coordinate orthant fan and each nonempty reduced intersection is the stated product. A full assignment with two signs of each kind is recovered from all its balanced supports, so gives a maximal face, and every maximal face arises this way. The p=2 versus p=3 facet size difference is (n−3)(n−5). For n=5 a line leaves exactly one sign free, giving precisely the two endpoint positive sets A⊂B of sizes 2 and 3. Each inclusion recovers its unique line. This proves the corrected two-graph distinction. The existing verify.py and verification notes still apply: the enumeration represents lines as inclusion edges and does not claim that the incidence bipartite graph has only 20 vertices.

originality.rationale: For the repaired statement the comparable local charts, codimension-three purity, and singular fixed-point counts are not new. The exact all-collection global gluing with its integral star-fan geometry, facet structure and concrete five-cycle graph identification survives those overlaps on the material inspected. The Desargues graph itself and subdivision operation are not novelty claims.
residual_risks: Same-object affine coverage is substantial, and the new global description is closely based on classical toric fan facts; no priority attributed to those ingredients. Calendar date does not establish priority.
Bounded indexed and primary-passage checks do not exclude equivalent global descriptions elsewhere, including unindexed sources; unproductive web lookup is not negative evidence.

value.rationale: The closed gluing rule describes an entire singular locus in unbounded dimension, determining both the incidence of arbitrarily many components and the varieties appearing on every nonempty reduced intersection. Fixed-chart counts alone cannot be used in place of this global information. The corrected five-cycle figure is a concrete finite geometric specialization of that rule, not the sole basis for value.
